description: This file defines the ShoppingCart class, which models a shopping cart in an e-commerce system. It includes fields for cart identification, associated items, merchant store, customer details, and audit information. It also contains annotations for ORM mapping and persistence handling.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Represents a customer's shopping cart with associated items, merchant store, customer ID, and audit info. It manages persistence details through JPA annotations and tracks its state for e-commerce operations.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit-related metadata.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section for this shopping cart.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Indicates whether the shopping cart is obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Sets the obsolete status of the shopping cart.

methods.name: getLineItems
methods.description: Retrieves the set of items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: setLineItems
methods.description: Sets the items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Gets the unique code associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for the shopping cart.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID associated with the cart.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for the cart.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this cart.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the shopping cart.
